shouldFlag: no cruise ship experience anywhere in the CV
no seafarer documents (C1/D visa, Seaman's Book, ENG1/Seafarer's Medical)
Constantia Uitsig role uses weak language — 'Contributed to', 'Supported' — undersells impact
no quantified scale context for venues (star rating, covers, guest numbers)
shouldNotFlag: 25% increase in wine club sign-ups — quantified achievement present
notes: Well-rounded sommelier with 5+ years across wine estates and fine dining. Strongest quantified bullet of this group at the land-based tier (25% club sign-ups at Hillcrest). WSET L2 plus Hospitality Management Diploma. Clean two-page format. The Constantia Uitsig section is weakened by passive language. No cruise or shipboard experience, no seafarer documents — the differentiating gap versus higher-ranked CVs. Ranks above Chilongo on quantified evidence and education breadth.
